comment: Measured from boot_b (Android boot image in use). boot_a uses the same addresses.

dtb.comment: boot_b carries a real DTB in the v2 dtb field: 179139 B at 0x47c80000, padded to 0x2c000, followed by the AVB footer. boot_a must keep it: the kernel cannot boot without its own DTB.

vendor_boot: present but all-zero on both slots
